company.shortDescription: Milango is a community management solution provider.
company.description: Milango provides community management solutions to closed communities with products tailored to gated compounds and sporting & social clubs, among other communities. The startup aims to provide all users with a SmarterLife every day, including a cashless environment, access control, facility management, even yacht docking, and more.
